steps.en: Register your app with each provider and put its keys in a CONFIG dict, one entry per provider
steps.zh: 到各家 provider 注册应用，key 写进 CONFIG 字典

steps.en: Create one Authomatic instance and one login route that accepts the provider name
steps.zh: 建一个 Authomatic 实例和一个带 provider 名的登录路由

steps.en: In that route, call login through your framework's adapter
steps.zh: 在路由里通过框架适配器调用 login

steps.en: Redirects the user to the provider and, on the callback, exchanges the code for credentials
steps.zh: 把用户重定向到 provider，回调时用授权码换回凭据

steps.en: Returns a result with a normalized user you can fill in from the provider's API
steps.zh: 返回一个结果，带统一格式的 user，可再向 provider API 补全资料

value.en: "Sign in with X" for many providers through one call, with no framework or user model imposed
value.zh: 一个调用接上多家“用 X 登录”，不强加框架和用户模型

sources: https://github.com/authomatic/authomatic examples/flask/werkzeug_adapter/main.py (Authomatic(CONFIG, "your secret string", ...), authomatic.login(WerkzeugAdapter(request, response), provider_name), result.user.update()) — read 2026-10-08
